first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: In frame 0 of this clip, Person A is in the near lower-left. A person with short dark hair, wearing a blue-gray top with rolled-up sleeves, brown trousers, and brown crossed shoulder straps; tracked by clothing and continuous action, with position subject to change with the camera.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The other person who continuously interacts with Person A in this clip. A person with relatively short gray-brown hair, wearing a dark crew-neck short-sleeved top and dark trousers; does not have Person A's crossed shoulder straps and continuously interacts with Person A while holding a sword.

entities.name: Sword A
entities.identification: The sword held by Person A, identified by Person A's grip on it and continuous action; a long curved blade and a metal guard near the hand are visible.

entities.name: Sword B
entities.identification: The sword held by Person B, identified by Person B's grip on it and continuous action; its designation does not change based on whether it is at the top or bottom of the image or on momentary reflections.

entities.name: Wooden Plank Floor
entities.identification: The continuous wooden plank surface beneath the people and between them, with seams extending into the distance; excludes the stairs above, the Pillar, and scattered metal objects.

entities.name: Metal Debris on the Ground
entities.identification: The collection of disc-shaped and irregular small metal objects scattered and piled on the Wooden Plank Floor; individual objects are not numbered, and Sparks from Clashing Swords in the air are excluded.

entities.name: Pillar
entities.identification: Thick upright columnar structural elements indoors, visible at the sides and in the background; defined separately from the closely spaced rods of the Grating.

entities.name: Background Wall Rack
entities.identification: The background structure composed of large dark wall surfaces, frame edges, and elevated beam racks behind the people, excluding the separately defined Pillar, Grating, Background Stairs, and Box.

entities.name: Background Stairs
entities.identification: The stairs in the background composed of several horizontal steps rising progressively, located behind the people and excluding ordinary floorboard seams.

entities.name: Box
entities.identification: The collection of low rectangular box-like containers in the background, with square frames, metal edges, and open or tilted lid surfaces visible; only the areas visible in this clip are counted.

entities.name: Flames
entities.identification: Orange-yellow tongues of fire visible near the Pillar, wall rack, and background edges; excludes the white flashes and brief sparks that appear when the swords clash.

entities.name: Sparks from Clashing Swords
entities.identification: Bright fragments and short streaks that briefly scatter near where the two swords meet, appearing and dissipating with the sword-clashing action; excludes stationary Metal Debris on the Ground and environmental Flames.
